message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (estimated)**  

| Item | Approximate Cost (₹) | Notes |
|------|----------------------|-------|
| Base Model S (Long‑Range) | ₹1,50,000 – ₹1,60,000 k | Roughly $200,000–$220,000 USD |
| Import duties & GST | +₹30,000 – ₹40,000 k | 20 % GST + customs duties on imported cars |
| Local taxes & fees | +₹10,000 – ₹15,000 k | State‑specific road tax, registration, etc. |
| **Total** | **₹1,90,000 – ₹2,10,000 k** | ≈ $260,000–$280,000 USD |

> **Why this estimate?**  
> • Tesla has not officially launched in India yet, so there is no published MSRP.  
> • The above figure is derived from the U.S. price (~$200k) plus typical Indian import duties (≈20 % GST + customs) and local taxes.  
> • Actual launch price could vary depending on Tesla’s pricing strategy, local incentives, and changes in duty rates.

**Bottom line:** If Tesla were to launch the Model S in India, you could expect a price in the ballpark of ₹1.9–2.1 million (≈$260k–$280k).
